This beta keeps every enabled provider current in the background and makes it clearer exactly which activity each usage source includes.

## Improvements

- OpenCode Go now distinguishes this-PC-only local estimates from separate OpenCode Console organisation billing, including clearer spend comparisons and coverage labels.
- Antigravity now identifies its reading as backend quota for the account signed in to `agy`, with clearer guidance when the account or CLI needs attention.
- Provider refreshes are limited to a small concurrent batch, avoiding a burst of command-line tools when several providers update together.

## Fixes

- Enabled providers now refresh on schedule even when their tab is not selected or the UsageDeck window is hidden, keeping their usage and notifications current.
- Z.AI usage now supports both authentication formats used by its official tooling and existing integrations, and sign-in errors identify which regional endpoint rejected the key.
